purpose: Provides a non-normative common validation-structure reference for root/whole-checkout, repository-owned, and product-owned validation implementation; accepted repository specifications remain controlling authority.

scope.public_entry_points_location: scripts for root validation; <domain>/scripts for leaf validation

directories.purpose: Production validation rule implementation and domain-specific validation policy.
Shared validation infrastructure used by checks, runners, and tests.
Internal orchestration invoked by public validation and validation-test script entry points.
Root for validation-domain test implementation and test material.
Validation-framework self-tests and their support code.
Non-executable test inputs and fixture data.

files.purpose: Aggregates production validation checks owned by the validation domain.
Contains specification, manifest, reference, lifecycle-lineage, and specification-root validation owned by the domain.
Contains validation for governed development-document structure, metadata, correspondence, and chunk constraints.
Contains validation for generated-artifact correspondence and freshness.
Contains domain-specific production validation policy that does not belong to another standard check role.
Defines validation context objects and authority/domain loading mechanics.
Defines shared validation failure and expectation helpers.
Defines reusable invariant and structural-validation helpers.
Defines JSON loading and supported schema-validation mechanics.
Runs production validation for the owning validation domain.
Runs validation-framework self-tests independently from ordinary unit tests.
Provides reusable support for mutation-oriented validation self-tests.
Contains mutation-oriented validation-framework self-tests invoked explicitly by the validation self-test runner.

rules: Ordinary unit tests belong under tests/unit/.
Discoverable unit-test modules use the test_*.py filename convention.
Adding a conforming unit-test module does not require editing a central registry or custom run_tests.py aggregator.
Validation-framework self-tests belong under tests/self/ and are invoked independently from ordinary unittest discovery.
Non-executable fixture data belongs under tests/fixtures/.

placement_rules.place_under: scripts/ for root validation; <domain>/scripts/ for leaf validation

extension_rules: The common baseline files remain present even when a domain currently has no specialized logic for a role.
Domain-specific specialization directories may be added only when the concern does not fit an existing standard directory role.
A domain-specific addition does not become part of validation_reference unless it is intentionally adopted as common baseline structure.
The logical roles in this manifest are authoritative over historical file placement.

Creating a new non-test validation file outside the canonical baseline is exceptional; ordinary new validation logic must be placed in an existing canonical file role whenever that role can reasonably own the responsibility.
A new non-test domain-specific validation file requires a clearly justified specialization boundary that cannot be represented cleanly by an existing canonical file role.
Test modules and fixture files may be added under tests/unit, tests/self, or tests/fixtures according to their declared test role without requiring a non-test specialization justification.
The checks/ directory is an exact mirror of the canonical reference check-file set; additional domain-specific check modules are not permitted.

directory_file_constraints.purpose: The live validation checks directory mirrors the reference check-file set exactly. Domain-specific check behavior is folded into the canonical role files rather than creating additional check modules.
